description:

------------

Marsh

----------------

Marsh is seeking a Vendor Risk Management expert for the following position based in the Pune, India office.

Work with Senior Business/OPS leaders Quality and Governance experts

An energizing culture to work in and exposure to tools and best practices.

Working with an energetic curious team of multi-disciplinary professionals

Opportunity to contribute to Operational outcomes and make an impact.

  
  

* Strategic Leadership: Develop and refine the third-party risk management strategy aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Risk Assessment & Due Diligence: Manage comprehensive risk assessments for high-risk vendors, including financial stability, cybersecurity, operational resilience, privacy/AI, compliance, and reputational risks.
* Policy & Framework Development: Establish, implement, and continuously improve policies, procedures, and standards for third-party risk management.
* Vendor Lifecycle Management: Oversee the entire vendor lifecycle, from onboarding and due diligence to ongoing monitoring and offboarding.
* Risk Monitoring & Reporting: Design and oversee the implementation of key risk indicators (KRIs), dashboards, and reporting mechanisms for senior management and risk committees.
* Regulatory & Industry Compliance: Ensure all third-party activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, SOC, etc.).
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with legal, procurement, compliance, IT, and other risk management functions to evaluate vendor risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Third-Party Risk Program Oversight: Lead the third-party risk management team, providing mentorship, guidance, and performance management.
* Issue & Incident Management: Oversee the investigation and resolution of third-party risk incidents, including breach or compliance issues.
* Audit & Review: Coordinate internal and external audits related to third-party risk, ensuring timely remediation of identified issues.
* Training & Awareness: Promote a risk-aware culture through training programs, workshops, and communication initiatives.
* External Relationships: Manage relationships with external vendors, risk assessment providers, and industry forums.
  

**What you need to have:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree with 8-10 years of experience. Masters preferred
* > 5 years of experience in third-party/vendor risk management, compliance, or related fields
* Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks, industry standards, and best practices related to third-party risk.
* Proven experience managing complex vendor portfolios, including high-risk or strategic vendors.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, data privacy, operational resilience, and contractual risk mitigation.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and implement risk management frameworks and policies.
* Excellent leadership, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Professional certifications such as Certified Third Party Risk Professional (CTPRP), Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or equivalent are highly desirable.
  

  

**What makes you stand out?**

  

* Experience in highly regulated industries such as financial services, Insurance, or technology.
* Familiarity with third-party risk management tools and platforms.
* Understanding of Procurement functions such as Sourcing, Contracting, Vendor Operations and Buyer functions.
* Ability to influence organizational culture and promote risk awareness.
* Strong communication skills, capable of presenting complex risk issues to executive leadership.
  

  

**Why join our team:**

  

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.

* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.

* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

* Track student requests, complaints, and pending activities.
* Ensure timely responses and appropriate resolution.
* Escalate critical or unresolved matters to management.
* Maintain records of issues and resolutions.

* Maintain daily operational checklists and follow-up trackers.
* Monitor attendance, trainer availability, assessments, student communication, fee follow-ups, and placement activities.
* Ensure that no important student or operational activity is missed or left unattended.

* Strong coordination and follow-up skills.
* Good working knowledge of **MS Excel / Google Sheets**.
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple students, batches, trainers, and activities simultaneously.
* Good problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Professional communication with students, parents, trainers, counsellors, accounts, placement teams, and management.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

* Proactive and responsible approach.

* Training Institute / Education Operations
* Student Relationship Management
* EdTech Operations
* CRM / Student Management Systems
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets
* MIS Reporting
* WhatsApp Business / Community Management
* Placement Coordination
* Academic Coordination
* Fee Follow-Up and Payment Tracking
* LMS / Digital Learning Platforms
* Customer Service / Student Support

The ideal candidate is a **highly organized, proactive, responsible, and student-focused professional** who can manage multiple activities without losing track of details.

The candidate should be comfortable working with students and coordinating with multiple internal teams.

Instead, the candidate should think:

**"I will follow up until the activity is completed."**

The ability to identify pending work, take ownership, coordinate with the right people, and ensure closure will be critical for success in this role.

**Department**

  

Customer Services

  

  

**Division**

  

Kohler India Technical Center, Pune

AM

Manager – Customer Care

We (Kohler India Technical Center) are a captive global center providing technical and nontechnical support for all the businesses and product lines for Kohler India (Kitchen and Bath).


As a Customer Care Assistant Manager at Kohler, you will be responsible for managing the daily operations of our Customer Care department. You will oversee a team of customer care associates, ensuring that they provide excellent service to our end consumers. In this role, you will be responsible for setting goals and metrics, monitoring performance, and implementing strategies to improve customer experience. You will also work closely with other departments to ensure smooth operations and effective communication.


**Role and Responsibility:**


**Be a Brand Ambassador for our customers by building relationships and creating loyalty**. Provide world\-class first level inbound phone/chat/email support for customers by troubleshooting, investigating, and resolving customers' inquiries about Kohler India products with the goal of resolving each issue on the first contact. You will be expected to provide empathetic, courteous, quality customer service in an accurate and timely manner in accordance with Kohler protocols while maintaining a positive, problem\-solving approach.

  

* Manage and oversee the daily operations of the Customer Care department.
* Hire, train, and supervise a team of customer service associates.
* Set performance goals and metrics for the team and monitor progress.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve customer experience.
* Maintain and improve customer service level agreements and procedures.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and provide regular reports to senior management.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as sales, marketing, and operations, to ensure smooth operations and effective communication.
* Develop and maintain relationships with key customers.
* Provide coaching and feedback to team members to improve their performance and development.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiencies.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures, as well as applicable regulations and laws.

* Bachelor’s degree mandatory – master’s degree preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in customer service or related field, with at least 5 years in a people management role.
* Strong leadership, Problem solving and People management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop strategies.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and customer service software.

* Frequent interaction with internal stakeholders including senior leadership team.
